verdict.rationale: Capacities documents [[ ]] (and @) linking to existing content and a dedicated "Backlinks" section at the bottom of each object, which covers the core of wiki-style linking with backlinks. The pack has no evidence of unlinked-mention detection and does not say whether backlinks are shown with surrounding context. The daily-notes "mentions of the day" refers to references, not unlinked mentions. Missing for 10: unlinked mentions, backlinks shown in context, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can link notes with [[wiki-style]] links and see every backlink and unlinked mention of a note in context

citations.quote: Use `@` or `[[]]` to link to existing content.
All backlinks are grouped together at the bottom of your object in a section titled "Backlinks".
